Since 1947

San Leandro's Little Bar
With Big Character

Cunha's has been pouring drinks inside the Pelton Center — California's first shopping center — since 1947, which makes it one of the longest-running bars in San Leandro. The building's changed hands a few times over the decades, but the feeling hasn't: walk in and you're a regular by your second visit.

It's a dive bar at heart with a neon glow on top — pool table, digital dartboards, a jukebox loaded with everything, and enough TVs that you'll never miss a Raiders, Niners, or Warriors game. Grab a stool, order something stiff, and stay a while.
